findings.opportunity: handleImageExport returns early for non-model views without clearing sessionStorage, so a snapshot left by a prior Model View PNG/JPG export is later read unconditionally by any authored-view export page, seeding its diagram machine with foreign focus/expanded and gating its download behind ApplyXirangExportState — contradicting the documented no-snapshot fallback for non-Xirang views.
findings.impact: Restores the design's no-snapshot fallback invariant for authored-view exports; removes latent foreign-state seeding and download gating on non-Xirang export pages; no change to any exported image.
evidence: Header.tsx:120-127 handleImageExport returns early for non-model views without clearing sessionStorage
ExportPage.tsx:154 reads xirang:export-snapshot unconditionally at mount
ExportPage.tsx:305-306,327 seeds initialFocusIdentity/initialExpanded and mounts ApplyXirangExportState whenever a snapshot exists
design.md: non-Xirang views and other formats keep existing behavior; no-snapshot falls back
findings.recommendation: In handleImageExport, for the non-model branch call clearXirangExportSnapshotFromStorage() before returning.
findings.keyDesign: Single owner for the storage key: Header is the only writer and every export click first reconciles the key to the intended state (model view -> write/clear current snapshot; any other view -> always clear).
preservationConstraints: Model View PNG/JPG clicks must still write the current module snapshot to sessionStorage before the export tab opens
Authored-view exports must keep producing the same image; clearing only removes latent machine seeding and ApplyXirangExportState gating
Storage side effects stay limited to the export click; no change to the module store or ExportPage read logic
implementationOutline: In handleImageExport, replace the bare early return with clearXirangExportSnapshotFromStorage() for non-model views
validation: Existing export-state unit tests remain green
e2e C8 still passes: model-view PNG click writes the snapshot with focus and expanded
e2e C10 still passes: direct export URL without snapshot falls back
findings.priorityReason: Only finding that removes latent state-dependent behavior contradicting the documented fallback invariant; one-branch change with high confidence and low risk.

findings.opportunity: The new spec asserts WYSIWYG node-set equality using hard-coded sleeps (waitForTimeout(600)/1000) that can flake or assert a stale DOM on slow CI.
findings.impact: Deterministic assertions bound to the actually-rendered node set; the WYSIWYG equivalence claim is proven by polling the real DOM instead of a fixed time budget.
evidence: semantic-browser-image-export.spec.ts:57 waitForTimeout(600) before the on-screen node-set equality assertion
semantic-browser-image-export.spec.ts:73,99,106 waitForTimeout(1000) before export-page node assertions
visibleNodeIds(page) already isolates the asserted signal
findings.recommendation: Replace each node-set sleep with expect.poll(async () => visibleNodeIds(page)).toEqual(expected).
findings.keyDesign: The asserted signal is already extracted into visibleNodeIds; poll until the set equals the baseline rather than sleeping a fixed budget.
preservationConstraints: Same node-id extraction and lexicographic sort semantics
Test 1 keeps the exact 4-node set equality; Test 2 keeps the change-source diff assertion; Test 3 keeps the non-empty fallback assertion
The initial .react-flow__pane visibility waits and pre-export state setup stay unchanged
implementationOutline: Replace waitForTimeout before node assertions with expect.poll(visibleNodeIds) over the same expected value
Keep sleeps only where they pace non-asserted UI transitions, or drop them once polling covers the assertion
Re-run the three tests against a rebuilt bundle
validation: pnpm exec playwright test test/e2e/semantic-browser-image-export.spec.ts --project=desktop — all 3 pass deterministically
Confirm the polled assertion still fails when WYSIWYG is broken
findings.priorityReason: Directly hardens the acceptance e2e that proves the feature; benefit is test reliability rather than product behavior.

findings.opportunity: Download scheduling is duplicated across onInitialized and handleSnapshotApplied (two setTimeout(...,500) sites guarded by two refs plus a downloadDiagramRef indirection); the first-scheduled timer in the snapshot path always fires as a no-op and the 500ms constant can drift.
findings.impact: Single source of truth for the snapshot-applied AND diagram-initialized trigger; removes the guaranteed no-op timer and the duplicated 500ms constant.
evidence: ExportPage.tsx:192-193 snapshotAppliedRef/initializedRef
ExportPage.tsx:208-209 downloadDiagram early return on snapshotAppliedRef
ExportPage.tsx:234-240 downloadDiagramRef + setTimeout(downloadDiagramRef.current, 500)
ExportPage.tsx:320-323 onInitialized sets initializedRef and independently setTimeout(downloadDiagram, 500)
findings.recommendation: Introduce a single maybeScheduleDownload() guarding snapshotAppliedRef && initializedRef && !downloadedRef, call it from both onInitialized and handleSnapshotApplied, delete the inline setTimeout branches, keep the 500ms constant in one place.
findings.keyDesign: One guard function over the two condition refs; both event sites invoke it; single 500ms schedule; keep downloadDiagramRef for closure freshness.
preservationConstraints: No-snapshot path must still download at onInitialized + 500ms exactly as today
Snapshot path must still download 500ms after the later of (applied, initialized)
Download still fires at most once and only when download=true
LoadingOverlay hide, triggerDownload, and window.close order remain unchanged
implementationOutline: Extract maybeScheduleDownload reading the three refs
Call it from onInitialized and handleSnapshotApplied
Remove the inline setTimeouts and the duplicated 500 constant
Re-run SPA typecheck and the download-path e2e tests
validation: e2e C8/C9 still capture the expected focused/diff view; direct export URL still downloads
findings.priorityReason: Maintainability: one scheduling path instead of two duplicated 500ms branches with a guaranteed no-op timer.

findings.opportunity: initialExpanded={snapshot ? new Set(...) : undefined} and initialFocusIdentity are re-derived on every GuardedExportPage render although the snapshot is frozen at mount and the machine consumes the seed only at actor creation.
findings.impact: Removes per-render Set/derivation churn on the export page and makes the seeded-once-at-mount intent explicit.
evidence: ExportPage.tsx:154 snapshot read once via useState initializer
ExportPage.tsx:305-306 inline new Set(snapshot.expanded) per render
DiagramActorProvider.tsx useActorRef consumes input only at actor creation
findings.recommendation: Derive focus/expanded in the same mount-time initializer and thread the precomputed values into GuardedExportPage.
findings.keyDesign: Seed derivation colocated with the frozen snapshot read so it runs exactly once per export-page load.
preservationConstraints: For a given snapshot the values passed to LikeC4Diagram must be identical
Machine seeding semantics unchanged; no-snapshot path passes undefined/undefined
implementationOutline: Move focus/expanded derivation into the useState initializer next to the snapshot read
Pass precomputed values as props to GuardedExportPage
Run SPA typecheck and the e2e seeding test
validation: e2e C8 still renders the focused/expanded node set; e2e C10 still falls back
findings.priorityReason: Micro allocation/derivation removal on a page that re-renders rarely; trivially safe and cheap.

findings.opportunity: The read normalizer only checks typeof parsed.mode === 'string' before the unsound cast `parsed.mode as XirangViewMode`; a malformed mode flows into setMode and resolveEffectiveMode instead of failing fast to the null fallback.
findings.impact: Fail-closed normalization: any payload whose mode is not 'full' or 'diff' is rejected as null, keeping the export page on the default fallback and removing the type-unsound cast.
evidence: export-state.ts:37 typeof parsed.mode === 'string' guard
export-state.ts:41 `mode: parsed.mode as XirangViewMode`
ExportPage.tsx ApplyXirangExportState consumes snapshot.mode via setMode
findings.recommendation: Reject anything outside the 'full'|'diff' union (parsed.mode !== 'full' && parsed.mode !== 'diff'), replacing the unsound cast with a normalized union value.
findings.keyDesign: Normalize-to-null on any union violation, consistent with the existing malformed-payload handling.
preservationConstraints: All valid snapshots ('full' and 'diff') must round-trip identically
The returns-null-on-malformed contract extends to invalid mode values
No change to the writer, module store, or ExportPage consumption
implementationOutline: Add the union check to the existing guard
Add a spec case for an invalid mode returning null
validation: cd likec4 && pnpm --filter @likec4/diagram exec vitest run --no-isolate src/xirang/export-state.spec.ts
findings.priorityReason: Closes a type-unsoundness gap and extends fail-closed normalization; purely defensive.

findings.opportunity: Adding initialFocusIdentity/initialExpanded to Input widened the update.inputs event payload; updateInputs spreads them into context as inert fields because seeding only happens in Context() at actor creation, creating a silent no-op trap.
findings.impact: Keeps the machine's public event contract honest: the update channel no longer advertises mount-only seed fields that have no runtime effect.
evidence: machine.setup.ts:88-90 Input gains the seed fields
machine.setup.ts:239 update.inputs payload now includes them
machine.actions.ts:158-161 updateInputs stores them as inert keys
DiagramActorProvider.tsx sends only the six runtime toggles
findings.recommendation: Exclude the seed fields from the update.inputs payload type by extending the Omit union with 'initialFocusIdentity' | 'initialExpanded'.
findings.keyDesign: Seed fields are creation-time-only by design; the update channel must not advertise values it cannot apply.
preservationConstraints: No current caller sends these fields via update.inputs
Type-level change only — zero runtime behavior change
Interactive view and export page seeding unchanged; existing seeding specs remain green
implementationOutline: Change the update.inputs Omit key union to include 'initialFocusIdentity' | 'initialExpanded'
Run diagram typecheck and machine.setup unit test

findings.priorityReason: Type-honesty cleanup with no runtime effect; closes a genuine API trap introduced by this change.
